description: Submit a creation request whose attribute map varies in size and key ordering, including an empty map and maps with several keys supplied out of alphabetical order. The controller builds a record from the submitted attributes and asks the data store to persist it. On successful persistence the response is a redirect to the canonical URL of the newly created member and a success flash notice naming the resource. The transcript renders the submitted fields as a key-sorted, comma-separated list.

cases.expected_output:
store=build attrs={}
store=save ok=true
assign=article
status=302
redirect=http://test.host/articles/42
flash.notice=Article was successfully created.

store=build attrs={apple=a,mango=m,zebra=z}
store=save ok=true
assign=article
status=302
redirect=http://test.host/articles/7
flash.notice=Article was successfully created.

store=build attrs={body=straße,title=café}
store=save ok=true
assign=article
status=302
redirect=http://test.host/articles/8
flash.notice=Article was successfully created.
